meta.title: MBA in Marketing Strategy & Branding in Mumbai – ATLAS ISME
meta.description: Build marketing skills in branding, consumer behavior, digital strategy, insights, campaigns and business growth tools.

hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: MBA in Marketing at ATLAS ISME

text:
is built for future CMOs, brand leaders, digital marketers, and consumer strategists. Whether you want to craft powerful brands, design breakthrough campaigns, or shape global consumer trends — this program gives you the skills to excel in a fast-evolving marketplace.

You’ll learn to integrate

text.strong: creativity with analytics, consumer insights with digital strategy, and branding with innovation

text: . From product management to brand storytelling, sales strategy to global marketing, advertising to social media — every subject is taught with real-world marketing applications.

cards.title: Master consumer insights and behavior-driven strategies.
Build, manage, and scale impactful brands.
Lead ethically with global marketing perspectives.
Drive business growth through innovative marketing leadership.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Builds strong foundations in marketing, consumer behavior, business communication, economics, and analytics, preparing students with strategic thinking and customer-centric decision-making skills.

title.strong: Professional Communication and Presentation Skills- Career and Leadership Development - I

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

courses.title: Driving Decisions by Excel And Modern Age AI Tools
courses.text: Master Excel from fundamentals to advanced analytics, covering data organisation, visualisation, forecasting, decision modelling, and generative AI tools to automate insights and solve complex business problems.

courses.title: Introduction to Digital Marketing
courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Early foundation in finance, global business, AI tools, leadership, and electives, blending theory with practical applications for future-ready financial expertise.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Introduces hyper-specialisation in marketing with brand management, global marketing, ethics, and applied projects, developing expertise in integrated campaigns and market expansion strategies.

courses.title: Managing Self and People Skills with Human Centered Design Thinking- Career and Leadership Development- II
courses.text: Develops emotional intelligence, leadership, and teamwork skills; applies design thinking for user-centric problem solving; and strengthens personal branding and networking to enhance professional presence and career growth

courses.title: CSR, SDGs, Business Research
courses.text: Explores corporate social responsibility, sustainable development goals, and business research methods to integrate ethical practices and informed decisions into corporate strategies.

courses.title: Behavior Based Selling & Negotiation (BBSN)
courses.text: Develops persuasive selling skills using psychology-driven negotiation strategies, enhancing customer engagement and achieving mutually beneficial outcomes in competitive business environments.

courses.title: Product & Brand Management
courses.text: Covers strategies to design, manage, and grow successful brands, emphasizing positioning, differentiation, and lifecycle management for sustained competitive advantage.

courses.title: Media Strategy
courses.text: This subject covers integrated media planning, media selection, and campaign optimisation in digital and traditional channels.

courses.title: Retail & E-commerce Strategy
courses.text: Students analyse modern retail formats, omnichannel experiences, and digital commerce ecosystems. The course equips learners to develop data-driven retail strategies that enhance customer engagement and drive conversion.

items.title: Marketing Laws and Ethics
items.text: Examines ethical frameworks, consumer rights, and legal regulations guiding marketing practices, ensuring responsible decision-making and compliance in diverse business contexts.

items.title: Marketing for Global Markets
items.text: Develops skills to design, adapt, and implement international marketing strategies, navigating cultural diversity, global competition, and dynamic international trade environments.

compare.title: Why our semester 2 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Focus on self-leadership, innovation, sustainability, branding, and applied marketing practices with early electives, shaping adaptable professionals ready for evolving business challenges.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Focuses on advanced digital marketing, advertising, and analytics while strengthening leadership, resilience, and applied research for real-world marketing innovation and competitiveness.

courses.title: Organizational Behaviour & Human Values - Career and Leadership Development - III
courses.text: Learn to make strategic, big-picture decisions by evaluating competition, allocating resources, and planning for long-term success, while developing adaptability, resilience, and effective leadership in dynamic environments.

courses.title: Economics and Cyber Governance
courses.text: Applies economic theories to real-world business challenges, analyzing data, assessing trade-offs, and making strategic decisions, while integrating cybersecurity, risk management, and digital resilience for technology-driven business protection.

courses.title: Internship Dissertation
courses.text: Provides hands-on industry experience and research opportunities, enabling practical application of skills, problem-solving, and development of actionable insights for real-world business challenges.

courses.title: Marketing Analytics for Managers
courses.text: Equips managers with data-driven insights, predictive tools, and applied analytics to optimize campaigns, enhance decision-making, and drive measurable results.

courses.title: Legal and Ethical Aspects of Marketing
courses.text: Examines laws, ethical dilemmas, and compliance in advertising, branding, and consumer protection, ensuring responsible, transparent, and fair marketing practices.

courses.title: Sales and Distribution Management
courses.text: Covers the design and management of sales networks, channel structures, and distribution logistics. Strengthens operational planning and market execution strategies for effective revenue generation.

courses.title: B2B Marketing
courses.text: Focuses on marketing principles tailored to business-to-business environments and industrial markets. Examines buyer behavior, value creation, and long-term relationship-building in complex ecosystems.

items.title: Behavioral Science
items.text: Explores psychological drivers behind consumer choices, enabling marketers to design persuasive campaigns, improve engagement, and influence purchasing decisions effectively.

items.title: Marketing of Luxury Brands
items.text: Focuses on exclusivity, heritage, and aspirational value in luxury marketing, teaching strategies for branding, positioning, and global consumer engagement.

compare.title: Why our semester 3 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Integrates ethics, consumer trust, data-driven marketing, resilience, and specialization through applied projects and electives, preparing leaders for global, digital, and niche marketing landscapes.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: Emphasizes strategic marketing leadership, corporate governance, supply chain integration, and capstone projects, preparing graduates for global marketing leadership and entrepreneurial excellence.

courses.title: Corporate Governance, Professional Ethics & Law - Career and Leadership Development - IV
courses.text: Covers governance, legal frameworks, and ethics, ensuring compliance and accountability, while emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and capstone projects to apply leadership in solving complex, real-world business challenges.

courses.title: Corporate Strategy & Supply Chain Analytics
courses.text: Teaches analytical tools to optimize supply chains for efficiency, sustainability, and responsiveness, while providing corporate strategy frameworks to develop critical thinking, long-term vision, and effective business leadership.

courses.title: International Marketing
courses.text: Focuses on global markets, cultural insights, and cross-border strategies, preparing marketers to design effective campaigns and manage brands internationally with confidence.

courses.title: Sustainable Marketing in Practice
courses.text: Teaches eco-conscious marketing, sustainability-driven consumer behavior, and green branding strategies with hands-on projects to align business growth with environmental responsibility.

courses.title: Marketing for the Hinterlands
courses.text: This subject examines rural markets, low-income consumer behaviour, and last-mile distribution models. Students learn to design inclusive, context-specific marketing strategies for underserved populations.

courses.title: Services Marketing
courses.text: Students explore the unique characteristics of service businesses, including intangibility, variability, and customer experience management.

items.title: Creator Economy
items.text: Explores influencer ecosystems, digital creators, and monetization models, preparing marketers to leverage creator-led economies for impactful campaigns and innovative brand strategies.

items.title: Chanakya’s Arthashastra
items.text: Blends ancient Indian strategic wisdom with modern marketing, offering timeless lessons in governance, leadership, and resource management for sustainable competitive advantage.

compare.title: Why our semester 4 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Bridges governance, analytics, strategy, inclusive leadership, and advanced marketing with applied projects and electives, preparing industry-ready professionals for global, digital, and specialized markets.
